notes: The light moves through the day: low sun throws beams across the water (best on a foggy morning), and the sun now rises over the far shore and sets behind the trees, both in view.
Mist lies on the lake at first light and a haze comes back at dusk. On clear days the sun's path twinkles on the water and cloud shadows slide over the lake and the dock.
Lanterns, windows and fireflies glow softly after dark, and on clear, moonless nights the Milky Way arcs over the lake and shows in the still water.
Rain sweeps past in sheets and each drop kicks up a tiny crown. When a fish breaks the surface, white water bursts up, the spray catches the light and a ring of foam spreads out.
Camera zooms and pans glide smoothly instead of stepping.
New Options > Display > Light effects: Full, or Simple for slower computers. Controller rumble has moved to the Gameplay tab.
